scope: Public source and connection references. Source availability does not establish deployment, account access, or operational authority.

capabilities.name: Portfolio and accountable work
capabilities.description: Inspect ventures, track work and decisions, and preserve evidence in a tenant workspace.
requires: Verify Access identity and tenant storage
capabilities.verification: Cloud plugin source inspected. The private /healthz probe returned 404 on 4 October; authenticated calls remain unverified.

capabilities.name: Portable Starlight workflows
capabilities.description: Use the four existing skills for portfolio status, execution, decisions, and knowledge retrieval.
requires: Connect the workspace MCP for private records
capabilities.verification: Four source skills inspected; host installation is a separate check.

capabilities.name: Department package planning
capabilities.description: Inspect public package truth and compile a deterministic installation plan.
capabilities.verification: Public MCP initialize, discovery of four tools, and list_department_packages passed on 4 October. Host connection and private account operations remain separate.

capabilities.name: Skill and agent foundry
capabilities.description: Compile skills, justified agents, bounded systems, and evidence using the existing Foundry source.
requires: Validate the output in its target host
capabilities.verification: Foundry package present on inspected main; no hosted worker is implied.

capabilities.name: Academy practice
capabilities.description: Practice teaching methods and challenges while preserving attempts, critique, and transfer.
requires: Verify a practice loop in the host
capabilities.verification: Public MCP initialize and discovery of four Academy tools passed on 4 October. A completed practice loop remains unverified; no credential is awarded.

capabilities.name: Creator studio skills
capabilities.description: Compose production workflows from the shared studio skills while keeping the creator's output and distribution separate.
requires: Resolve the creator's actual source and export target
capabilities.verification: Studio package present on inspected main; website availability is not a production-job claim.

workflows.name: Review a website change
stages: Resolve the owning repository and current PR
Build the exact commit in a preview
Capture required routes on desktop and mobile
workflows.acceptance: Screenshots, assertions, and deployment identify the same commit. A capture alone does not establish functional success.

workflows.name: Create a finished edition
stages: Select the source and the reader
Export the signed edition and distribution draft
workflows.acceptance: The export can be opened and reused; brand, source lineage, and human review remain attached.

workflows.name: Build an Arcanea asset
stages: Prepare the character or environment specification
Register provenance and prepare the gallery release
workflows.acceptance: The asset matches the selected canon and visual direction, with a retained source and generation record.

workflows.name: Practice and build a package
stages: Build and test the portable package
workflows.acceptance: A fresh host can use the package on a real task; the result and remaining limitations are recorded.
